meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查 Codex 与 LazyCodex 安装,揪出过时或损坏的配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用 LazyCodex 或 Codex,想确认本地安装健康、与最新版一致。
copy.tagline_en: Check Codex and LazyCodex installs for drift, staleness, or breakage.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and worry your local install may be unhealthy or outdated.

howto.what: Claude 会检查你本地的 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 安装,同步最新源码做比对,输出一份 PASS/WARN/FAIL 报告,每条结论都附上产生它的命令输出或文件。它只做诊断,不修改你的安装、配置或仓库。
howto.when: 当你说 “doctor” 或 “健康检查”,提到 LazyCodex 等关键词,或安装、更新、改配置后 Codex 行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我跑一下 doctor,看看我的 LazyCodex 安装健不健康。
say.note: 会拉取最新源码比对并出报告。

say.text: 我更新完 Codex 后行为有点怪,帮我查一下原因。
say.note: 逐项检查版本、配置和插件载荷。

say.text: 看看我的 Codex 支不支持 gpt-6-astra 这个模型。
say.note: 检查 Astra 就绪度并给出升级建议。

howto.what_en: Claude inspects your local LazyCodex and Codex CLI install and compares it against the latest sources. It returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence for each verdict, and only diagnoses: it never edits your install, config, or repos.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a doctor or health check, mention LazyCodex, or Codex misbehaves after an install, update, or config change.

say_en.text: Run the doctor on my LazyCodex install.
Codex acts odd after my update — check the cause.
say_en.note: Probes version, config, and plugin payload.

say_en.text: Does my Codex support the gpt-6-astra model?
say_en.note: Checks Astra readiness and suggests an upgrade.
